title: Finite disjoint union assembly of representing sections
statement: Let i:Z→X be any morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], F a sheaf of sets on X_et [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], and t a section of i_et^*F at the base change of the identity X-object. Let J be a finite universe-u type, U_j etale X-objects whose images cover X, and s_j in F(U_j). If i^*s_j equals the restriction of t for every j, there is a universe-u scheme U with an etale surjective q:U→X and s in F(U) whose inverse-image unit equals t restricted to U times_X Z. The empty family is allowed.

proof.text: Form the scheme coproduct of the underlying U_j. Its coprojections cover it by pairwise disjoint open immersions. Etale locality on the source gives the etale induced structure map q, and the image-cover hypothesis directly gives surjectivity.

proof.text: A section family on a disjoint cover is compatible: same-index comparison arrows are equal by monicity; distinct-index comparison arrows have empty source, whose sheaf values are terminal by the empty cover. Apply the sheaf amalgamation axiom to get s and its component restrictions.

theorem etale_finite_family_section_gluing
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (t : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj F).obj.obj
      (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)))))
    {J : Type u} [Finite J] (U : J → X.Etale)
    (s : ∀ j, F.obj.obj (op (U j)))
    (hcover : (Set.univ : Set X) ⊆ ⋃ j, Set.range (U j).hom)
    (heq : ∀ j, etaleSetDescentUnit i F (U j) (s j) =
        ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj F).obj.map
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).map
            (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (U j).hom (Category.comp_id _) :
              U j ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))).op t) :
    ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (q : U ⟶ X) (_ : Etale q) (_ : Surjective q)
      (s : F.obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk q))),
      etaleSetDescentUnit i F (Scheme.Etale.mk q) s =
        ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj F).obj.map
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).map
            (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk q (Category.comp_id q) :
              Scheme.Etale.mk q ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))).op t
